shots.scene: 欣欣站在一摞空白复习卡片旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a tall stack of blank review cards on a desk and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，把辐射防护从头复习一遍。
overlay: 辐射防护总复习：从剂量到屏蔽

shots.scene: 五个图标排成一行：尺子、地球、细胞、限速牌、盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a ruler, a globe, a cell, a blank speed-limit style round sign, and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量、本底、效应、限值、屏蔽。

shots.scene: 核物理实验室里，阿杰打开一台计数器，桌上没有放射源，计数器在跳数
shots.prompt_en: In a nuclear physics teaching lab, the young male student switches on a handheld counter on an empty bench; the counter display flickers with changing blank digits.
shots.narration: 阿杰打开计数器，桌上并没有源。

shots.scene: 阿杰惊慌地后退，抱着头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student steps back in alarm, holding his head with both hands.
shots.narration: 可它一直在跳数，他吓坏了。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起电话想报警，小研按住他的手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student grabs a phone in a panic; the female graduate student, wearing a dosimeter badge, gently stops his hand.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：先别慌，这是本底。

shots.scene: 老周走过来，指着墙上紧锁的源柜
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks over and points to a locked metal source cabinet with an ionizing radiation warning sign on the wall.
shots.narration: 老周说：不放源也跳数，很正常。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们就从剂量单位开始复习。

shots.scene: 一只手被发光小箭头轻轻穿过，旁边亮起警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon hand with small glowing arrows passing through it, and a yellow warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射可能伤害生物体。

shots.scene: 放大镜对准细胞
shots.prompt_en: A large magnifying glass focused on a round cell. No people.
shots.narration: 所以要准确弄懂，它怎样伤人。

shots.scene: 五级台阶，每级一个图标
shots.prompt_en: A staircase of five steps, each step carrying one icon: ruler, globe, cell, round sign, shield. No people.
shots.narration: 五个部分，一步一步往上走。

shots.scene: 四级积木塔，从下往上一块压一块
shots.prompt_en: A tower of four building blocks of different colors stacked one on top of another. No people.
shots.narration: 四个剂量量，像积木层层往上搭。

shots.scene: 第二块积木稳稳压在第一块上
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of the second block resting firmly on the first block, with a small arrow pointing upward. No people.
shots.narration: 每一个，都建立在前一个之上。

shots.scene: 最上面两块积木贴着同样的空白标签，但颜色不同
shots.prompt_en: The top two blocks carry identical blank tags but have clearly different colors. No people.
shots.narration: 后两个单位都叫希沃特，含义却不同。

shots.scene: X射线、γ射线波浪穿过一团空气，空气里冒出小正负号
shots.prompt_en: Wavy ray lines pass through a puffy cloud of air, and tiny plus and minus signs pop out inside the cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 照射量，看X、γ射线在空气里电离多少。

shots.scene: 一张空白卡片钉在墙上，欣欣指着它
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a blank card pinned on the wall, nodding seriously.
shots.narration: 单位伦琴，等于万分之二点五八库仑每千克。

shots.scene: α粒子图标和人体图标被划上红叉，空气云打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An alpha particle icon and a human body icon are crossed out with red X marks, while an air cloud icon gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 它只管X、γ，只管空气。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓旁一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with a big question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 用在人体组织上，就不方便了。

shots.section_title: 照射率：看活度，也看距离
shots.scene: 放射源图标发出光线，旁边一个大桶和一个小桶
shots.prompt_en: A small source icon emitting rays; beside it a big bucket and a small bucket of glowing marbles. No people.
shots.narration: 源越强，照射率越高。
overlay: 照射率：看活度，也看距离

shots.section_title: 照射率：看活度，也看距离
shots.scene: 小人从源旁走远一步，光斑从四块变成一块
shots.prompt_en: A simple stick figure steps back from a source; the bright light patch on the floor spreads out and becomes four times fainter. No people.
shots.narration: 距离加倍，照射率降到四分之一。

shots.section_title: 照射率：看活度，也看距离
shots.scene: 几个不同的源罐，每个上面一个不同的小图标
shots.prompt_en: Several different small source containers, each with a different simple symbol on its lid. No people.
shots.narration: 每种核素，有自己的照射率常数。

shots.section_title: 照射率：看活度，也看距离
shots.scene: 小研在笔记本上抄写，桌上两个源罐图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student copies notes into a blank notebook, with two small source container icons on the desk.
shots.narration: 实验室常用的铯137和钠22，常数要记住。

shots.section_title: 照射率：看活度，也看距离
shots.scene: 四个源罐下方一张数值表
shots.prompt_en: Four small source containers with blank labels above a simple table with blank cells. No people.
shots.narration: 表里列有铯137、钴60、钠22和镭226。

shots.section_title: 吸收剂量：只说吸收多少能量
shots.scene: 一块组织方块被小球击中，方块变热发光
shots.prompt_en: A cube of tissue is hit by small balls and glows warm where energy is absorbed. No people.
shots.narration: 吸收剂量：每千克物质吸收多少能量。
overlay: 吸收剂量：只说吸收多少能量

shots.section_title: 吸收剂量：只说吸收多少能量
shots.scene: 天平一边是能量火苗，一边是砝码
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a small flame of energy on one side and a weight on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 单位叫戈瑞，是防护的基本量。

shots.section_title: 吸收剂量：只说吸收多少能量
shots.scene: 发光的方块旁打着问号，问号里是不同射线图标
shots.prompt_en: Next to the glowing cube, a question mark containing several different ray icons. No people.
shots.narration: 可它不说是哪种射线、来得多快。

shots.scene: 计数器空放在桌上，屏幕跳数
shots.prompt_en: A handheld counter lies alone on an empty bench, its blank display flickering. No people.
shots.narration: 计数器不放源，也会跳数。

shots.scene: 宇宙线从天而降，墙壁和地面也冒出小光点，都飞向计数器
shots.prompt_en: Tiny streaks fall from the sky while small sparks rise from the concrete walls and the ground, all flying toward the counter. No people.
shots.narration: 宇宙线、墙壁、地面，都有射线。

shots.scene: 计数器戴着眼罩，只顾数数
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon counter wearing a blindfold, happily counting with tally marks. No people.
shots.narration: 它只数能量，不认是谁来的。

shots.scene: 欣欣把眼罩计数器和发光方块放在一起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot places the blindfolded counter next to the glowing tissue cube and smiles.
shots.narration: 这就是吸收剂量的局限。

shots.scene: 一张空白卡片上画着箭头，从空气云指向发光方块
shots.prompt_en: A blank card with an arrow drawn from an air cloud icon to a glowing cube icon. No people.
shots.narration: 例题一：由照射量算空气吸收剂量。

shots.scene: 空气云里一对正负离子，旁边一个小电池图标
shots.prompt_en: Inside an air cloud, one pair of plus and minus ions with a small battery icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 一对离子约需33.7电子伏，得约8.67毫戈瑞。

shots.scene: 源图标、卷尺、计算器依次排开
shots.prompt_en: A source icon, a measuring tape and a calculator lined up in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 例题二：100微居里钠22源，距50厘米。

shots.scene: 箭头从计算器指向人体组织图标
shots.prompt_en: An arrow points from the calculator to a soft tissue icon. No people.
shots.narration: 照射率是每小时0.48毫伦。

shots.scene: 小研在空白作业纸上写下结果，画个框
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes a result on a blank worksheet and draws a box around it.
shots.narration: 软组织剂量率，每小时0.045毫戈瑞。

shots.section_title: 相对生物效应与传能线密度
shots.scene: 两个天平上放着同样重的砝码，旁边细胞一个轻伤一个重伤
shots.prompt_en: Two identical weights on two scales; beside them one cell is slightly bruised and another is badly damaged. No people.
shots.narration: 同样的吸收剂量，伤害可以不同。
overlay: 相对生物效应与传能线密度

shots.section_title: 相对生物效应与传能线密度
shots.scene: 一条路上脚印密集，另一条稀疏
shots.prompt_en: Two paths: one covered with dense footprints close together, the other with sparse footprints far apart. No people.
shots.narration: 关键看沿途沉积能量的密度。

shots.section_title: 相对生物效应与传能线密度
shots.scene: 保龄球沿途留下密集裂痕，乒乓球只留几点
shots.prompt_en: A bowling ball leaves a dense line of cracks along its path, while a ping-pong ball leaves only a few dots. No people.
shots.narration: α粒子、重离子，密集打击。

shots.section_title: 相对生物效应与传能线密度
shots.scene: γ射线细线稀疏穿过细胞
shots.prompt_en: Thin wavy lines pass sparsely through a cell, leaving only a few scattered dots. No people.
shots.narration: γ射线、电子，损伤稀疏分散。

shots.scene: 一个大胖粒子身上带很多电荷，吸走周围电子
shots.prompt_en: A big chubby cartoon particle covered with plus signs pulls many small electrons away from nearby atoms. No people.
shots.narration: α粒子个头大、电荷多，电离更密。

shots.scene: 电离火花被画成一个反派角色
shots.prompt_en: A small spark of ionization drawn as a cartoon villain with a mask. No people.
shots.narration: 在健康物理里，电离是头号敌人。

shots.scene: 复杂的分子积木被敲散
shots.prompt_en: A complex structure of linked molecular building blocks is knocked apart into pieces. No people.
shots.narration: 它会把复杂分子打散。

shots.scene: 一条小蛇图标旁，毒液小点沿血管扩散
shots.prompt_en: A small cartoon snake icon beside a blood vessel drawing where tiny venom dots spread along the vessel. No people.
shots.narration: 就像蛇毒随血液扩散，破坏复杂分子。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着手臂上一小块发亮的区域
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a small glowing patch on an arm outline.
shots.narration: 中低剂量下，损伤偏向局部。

shots.scene: 电离越多，破碎越多的对比图
shots.prompt_en: Two panels: few sparks with a slightly cracked structure, many sparks with a shattered structure. No people.
shots.narration: 电离越多，损伤就越重。

shots.section_title: 辐射权重因子像成绩等级
shots.scene: 成绩单上不同等级的空白徽章
shots.prompt_en: A report card with several blank grade badges of different sizes and colors. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射权重因子，像给射线打等级。
overlay: 辐射权重因子像成绩等级

shots.section_title: 辐射权重因子像成绩等级
shots.scene: 光子和电子图标戴着最小的徽章
shots.prompt_en: A photon wave icon and an electron dot icon each wear the smallest badge. No people.
shots.narration: 光子、电子，等级最低。

shots.section_title: 辐射权重因子像成绩等级
shots.scene: 中子图标戴着大小不同的几枚徽章
shots.prompt_en: A neutron ball icon wearing several badges of different sizes depending on its speed lines. No people.

shots.section_title: 辐射权重因子像成绩等级
shots.scene: α粒子图标戴着最大的徽章
shots.prompt_en: An alpha particle icon wears the largest, brightest badge. No people.
shots.narration: α粒子等级最高，最伤人。

shots.section_title: 辐射权重因子像成绩等级
shots.scene: 三级阶梯：电子、质子、α，依次升高
shots.prompt_en: Three rising steps: an electron icon on the lowest, a proton icon in the middle, an alpha icon at the top. No people.
shots.narration: α约是质子4倍，质子约是电子5倍。

shots.section_title: 当量剂量：把射线种类拉平
shots.scene: 吸收剂量方块乘上徽章，变成新的方块
shots.prompt_en: A glowing cube combined with a grade badge turns into a new cube of a different color. No people.
shots.narration: 吸收剂量乘权重，得到当量剂量。
overlay: 当量剂量：把射线种类拉平

shots.section_title: 当量剂量：把射线种类拉平
shots.scene: 天平两边：α图标和γ图标，各贴同样的空白标签，天平平衡
shots.prompt_en: A balanced scale with an alpha icon on one side and a gamma wave icon on the other, both with identical blank tags. No people.
shots.narration: 同样的希沃特，α和γ效果相当。

shots.section_title: 当量剂量：把射线种类拉平
shots.scene: 测量仪对着当量剂量方块，旁边一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A survey meter pointing at the new colored cube, with a question mark above it. No people.
shots.narration: 可当量剂量，不能直接测出来。

shots.section_title: 当量剂量：把射线种类拉平
shots.scene: 旧单位卡片和新单位卡片之间一个等号
shots.prompt_en: An old unit card and a new unit card with an equals sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 一希沃特等于一百雷姆。

shots.section_title: 有效剂量：器官敏感性不同
shots.scene: 人体轮廓上各器官亮起不同颜色
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with organs glowing in different colors. No people.
shots.narration: 同样剂量照到不同器官，风险不同。
overlay: 有效剂量：器官敏感性不同

shots.section_title: 有效剂量：器官敏感性不同
shots.scene: 每个器官旁一个大小不同的砝码
shots.prompt_en: Each organ in the body outline has a small weight of a different size beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 每个器官，有一个组织权重因子。

shots.section_title: 有效剂量：器官敏感性不同
shots.scene: 所有砝码汇成一个总数
shots.prompt_en: All the small weights slide together into one big weight labeled with a blank tag. No people.
shots.narration: 加起来，就是全身的有效剂量。

shots.section_title: 组织权重因子从数据里来
shots.scene: 一摞厚厚的档案和几十年的日历
shots.prompt_en: A tall pile of blank record folders beside a calendar with many pages flipping. No people.
shots.narration: 这些因子，来自几十年的人群数据。
overlay: 组织权重因子从数据里来

shots.section_title: 组织权重因子从数据里来
shots.scene: 旧版手册被新版手册替换
shots.prompt_en: An old blank handbook is replaced by a newer blank handbook with a small refresh arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 欣欣猜：人类在演化，因子也会变。

shots.section_title: 组织权重因子从数据里来
shots.scene: 皮肤图标戴小砝码，骨髓图标戴大砝码
shots.prompt_en: A skin icon with a tiny weight and a bone marrow icon with a much bigger weight. No people.
shots.narration: 皮肤权重低，骨髓、肺、胃、结肠较高。

shots.section_title: 组织权重因子从数据里来
shots.scene: 阳光照在手臂上，欣欣竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: Sunlight shines on an arm outline while the panda mascot gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 就像晒太阳，皮肤权重低算幸运。

shots.scene: 地球上空落下宇宙线，地面和房屋冒出小光点
shots.prompt_en: Tiny streaks fall from space onto the Earth, while houses and soil give off small glowing dots. No people.
shots.narration: 我们时刻受到天然和人工辐射。

shots.scene: 傍晚实验室，探测器连着空白屏幕，桌上无源
shots.prompt_en: An evening lab with a detector connected to a blank screen on an empty bench; a clock shows evening. No people.
shots.narration: 傍晚开机，不放源。

shots.scene: 早晨，屏幕上的计数柱长得很高
shots.prompt_en: Next morning, the clock shows morning and a bar on the screen has grown very tall. No people.
shots.narration: 第二天一看，本底计数很多。

shots.scene: 水泥墙里冒出小光点
shots.prompt_en: Small glowing dots drift out of a concrete wall. No people.
shots.narration: 水泥里的钾，就是来源之一。

shots.scene: 地球剖面，深处也有零星光点
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of the Earth with a few faint glowing dots even deep underground. No people.
shots.narration: 没有完全没有辐射的地方。

shots.scene: 小研把源放回屏蔽源罐，然后开机测量
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student uses long tweezers to put a small source back into a lead container, then starts the detector.
shots.narration: 测量前，先把源放回屏蔽罐。

shots.scene: 两根计数柱，一高一低，做减法
shots.prompt_en: Two count bars, a tall one and a short one, with a minus sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 先测本底，再测源，最后相减。

shots.scene: 一粒小光点淹没在一大片光点中
shots.prompt_en: One tiny special glowing dot hidden among a huge crowd of ordinary dots. No people.
shots.narration: 有的实验，信号比本底还弱。

shots.scene: 地下深处的实验室，头顶是厚厚岩层
shots.prompt_en: A small laboratory built deep underground, with thick rock layers above blocking falling streaks. No people.
shots.narration: 就把实验室建到地下，用岩层挡宇宙线。

shots.scene: 地下实验室墙壁用特殊的浅色砖块
shots.prompt_en: The underground lab walls are built from special pale bricks with no glowing dots. No people.
shots.narration: 墙也换成放射性低的材料。

shots.scene: 条形图：一根最长，一根其次，一根极短
shots.prompt_en: A bar chart with blank labels: one very long bar, one medium bar and one tiny bar. No people.
shots.narration: 公众受照，天然本底占大头。

shots.scene: 地下室里冒出淡淡的气体
shots.prompt_en: Faint gas wisps rising from the floor of a basement room. No people.
shots.narration: 其中最多的是吸入的氡。

shots.scene: 医院X光检查图标
shots.prompt_en: A hospital icon with a simple X-ray machine pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 第二位，是医学诊断检查。

shots.scene: 核电站冷却塔图标旁一根极短的条
shots.prompt_en: A cooling tower icon next to a very tiny bar. No people.
shots.narration: 核电正常运行，贡献很小。

shots.scene: 冷却塔图标旁打着警示三角
shots.prompt_en: The cooling tower icon with a yellow warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦泄漏，就是另一回事了。

shots.section_title: 本底随地点和海拔变化
shots.scene: 地图上几个地区颜色深浅不同
shots.prompt_en: A simple map with several regions shaded in different intensities. No people.
shots.narration: 本底随地点不同，能差两三倍。
overlay: 本底随地点和海拔变化

shots.section_title: 本底随地点和海拔变化
shots.scene: 高山上的宇宙线比山脚密
shots.prompt_en: Tiny streaks fall more densely on a mountaintop than at sea level below. No people.
shots.narration: 海拔越高越强，两千米处约翻倍。

shots.section_title: 本底随地点和海拔变化
shots.scene: 阿杰举手提问，背景是飞机图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to ask a question, with an airplane icon floating behind him.
shots.narration: 常坐飞机的人，受照也更多。

shots.scene: 射线直接打在DNA梯子上，梯子断开
shots.prompt_en: A ray hits a DNA ladder directly and snaps it. No people.
shots.narration: 第一条路：直接电离DNA，打断链条。

shots.scene: 射线打中水滴，冒出带刺火星飞向DNA
shots.prompt_en: A ray hits a water droplet, which releases spiky glowing sparks that fly toward the DNA ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 第二条路：打碎水，自由基再攻击DNA。

shots.scene: 小修理工把断口补好，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A tiny cartoon repair worker patches the DNA ladder; a green check mark appears. No people.
shots.narration: 细胞能修好的，就没有影响。

shots.scene: 修理工摊手，梯子仍然断着
shots.prompt_en: The tiny repair worker shrugs helplessly next to a DNA ladder that stays broken. No people.
shots.narration: 修不好，就有三种结局。

shots.scene: 细胞变灰枯萎
shots.prompt_en: A cell turns gray and shrivels. No people.
shots.narration: 一是细胞死亡，多了器官就出问题。

shots.scene: 一个人形图标身上一个异常细胞在变色
shots.prompt_en: A body outline icon with one abnormal cell changing color inside it. No people.
shots.narration: 二是躯体效应，最主要的是癌症。

shots.scene: 家谱图标，后代一格亮起
shots.prompt_en: A family tree icon where one box in the next generation lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 三是遗传效应，可能传给后代。

shots.scene: 正在分裂的细胞被闪电击中
shots.prompt_en: A dividing cell splitting in two is struck by a small lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 短时大剂量，先伤正在分裂的细胞。

shots.scene: 血滴、骨头、肠道三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a blood drop, a bone and a section of intestine. No people.
shots.narration: 血细胞、骨髓、肠道最先受影响。

shots.scene: 时间轴上四段：难受、平静、发病、恢复
shots.prompt_en: A timeline with four segments: a queasy face, a calm face, a sick face in bed, and a recovering face. No people.
shots.narration: 症状会经历几个阶段。

shots.scene: 一根火柴，摩擦不够不着火，够了才着火
shots.prompt_en: Two panels: a match rubbed gently stays unlit, a match rubbed hard bursts into flame. No people.
shots.narration: 像火柴要到燃点，低于阈值不出现。

shots.scene: 超过阈值后，红色条越来越长
shots.prompt_en: Past a marked line, a red bar grows longer and longer. No people.
shots.narration: 超过阈值，剂量越大越严重。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓从胚胎到成人一排，胚胎处亮红灯
shots.prompt_en: A row of silhouettes from an embryo to a child to an adult, with a red light glowing at the embryo. No people.
shots.narration: 不同人群阈值不同，胚胎胎儿最敏感。

shots.scene: 孕妇图标外围一圈防护光环
shots.prompt_en: A pregnant woman pictogram surrounded by a soft protective halo. No people.
shots.narration: 孕期受照，可能影响胎儿发育。

shots.scene: 一张彩票图标
shots.prompt_en: A lottery ticket icon with blank boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 低剂量，主要担心癌症和遗传效应。

shots.scene: 很长的时间轴，末端一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A very long timeline with a question mark far at the end. No people.
shots.narration: 潜伏期长，很难和其他原因分开。

shots.scene: 水杯一滴一滴积满
shots.prompt_en: A glass slowly filling up drop by drop. No people.
shots.narration: 没有阈值，看累积的总剂量。

shots.scene: 一条从原点出发的直线
shots.prompt_en: A simple straight line rising from the corner of a blank graph. No people.
shots.narration: 一般假定风险和剂量成正比。

shots.scene: 几个职业图标：安全帽、矿灯、方向盘、实验服
shots.prompt_en: Occupation icons in a row: a hard hat, a miner's lamp, a steering wheel and a lab coat. No people.
shots.narration: 比一比各种职业的风险。

shots.scene: 实验服图标旁的条最短
shots.prompt_en: A bar chart where the bar next to the lab coat icon is the shortest. No people.
shots.narration: 按规程工作的辐射人员，风险很小。

shots.scene: 小研戴剂量计、站在屏蔽后，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a dosimeter badge and standing behind a shield, gives a thumbs-up.
shots.narration: 懂防护、守规程，才最安全。

shots.scene: 天平一边是医疗科研图标，一边是警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with medical and research icons on one side and a warning triangle on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量限值，是收益和风险的平衡。

shots.scene: 国际组织的空白建议书，转交给各国的空白文件
shots.prompt_en: A blank recommendation booklet passed to several blank national rule books. No people.
shots.narration: 国际建议只是建议，各国自己定。

shots.scene: 两扇门：职业人员和公众
shots.prompt_en: Two doors with simple pictograms: a worker in a lab coat and a family. No people.
shots.narration: 限值分职业人员和公众两类。

shots.scene: 本底小条上再叠一段额外的条
shots.prompt_en: A short background bar with an extra segment stacked on top of it. No people.
shots.narration: 限值管的是本底之外的额外剂量。

shots.scene: 限值线向下移动的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A horizontal limit line moving downward with an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 1990年，按核爆幸存者剂量重估下调。

shots.scene: 实验室源柜里一排铅源罐
shots.prompt_en: A row of heavy lead source containers inside a locked source cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室的源，必须放在屏蔽里。

shots.scene: 源罐外，隔壁工作区的人轻松工作
shots.prompt_en: Outside the shielded container, a simple pictogram of a person working calmly in the next area. No people.
shots.narration: 让相邻区域的剂量足够低。

shots.scene: 铅原子图标像一张密网，接住γ射线
shots.prompt_en: A lead atom icon drawn as a dense net that catches incoming wavy rays. No people.
shots.narration: 铅原子序数高，最会吸收γ射线。

shots.scene: 五张卡片，每张一个射线图标
shots.prompt_en: Five blank cards in a row, each with a different radiation icon. No people.
shots.narration: 射线不同，屏蔽材料也不同。

shots.scene: γ射线撞上厚铅砖停下
shots.prompt_en: Wavy gamma rays stop against a thick gray lead brick. No people.
shots.narration: γ射线，用铅等重材料。

shots.scene: 电子先撞上透明板，再有薄铅在外
shots.prompt_en: Electrons first stop in a clear acrylic plate, with a thin gray lead layer behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 电子先用有机玻璃，强源外加铅。

shots.scene: 一张纸挡住α粒子
shots.prompt_en: A single sheet of blank paper stops alpha particles. No people.
shots.narration: α射程很短，一张纸就能挡住。

shots.scene: 中子先穿过一桶水变慢，再被重材料层挡住
shots.prompt_en: Fast neutron balls slow down passing through a tank of water and paraffin blocks, then a heavy layer behind absorbs the flashes. No people.
shots.narration: 中子先用含氢材料减速，再加重材料。

shots.scene: 粗大的混凝土墙
shots.prompt_en: A thick concrete wall around a large facility. No people.
shots.narration: 大型设施，常用混凝土。

shots.scene: 薄铅片挡住正电子，却冒出两道更亮的光
shots.prompt_en: A thin lead sheet stops a positron, but two brighter rays shoot out in opposite directions. No people.
shots.narration: 挡住正电子，又会冒出更强的光子。

shots.scene: 吃完大餐，提前准备好胃药
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon plate after a big meal with a small medicine box prepared next to it. No people.
shots.narration: 就像饭后，提前备好胃药。

shots.scene: 屏蔽设计图上同时画着主射线和次级射线
shots.prompt_en: A blank design sheet showing a shield that blocks both the main ray and the secondary rays. No people.
shots.narration: 设计屏蔽，要连次级辐射一起挡。

shots.scene: 铅、钢、水、石蜡、混凝土五种材料
shots.prompt_en: Five shielding material samples in a row: lead brick, steel plate, water tank, paraffin block and concrete block. No people.
shots.narration: 常用铅、钢、水、石蜡和混凝土。

shots.scene: 铅砖小巧却很重
shots.prompt_en: A small but heavy lead brick sitting next to a much bigger concrete block. No people.
shots.narration: 铅密度高、体积小，最常用。

shots.scene: 时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon with a short highlighted arc. No people.
shots.narration: 时间：在源旁边，尽量少待。

shots.scene: 尺子图标，小人退后
shots.prompt_en: A ruler icon with a simple stick figure stepping back from a source. No people.
shots.narration: 距离：退远一倍，剂量降到四分之一。

shots.scene: 砖墙图标挡在源和人之间
shots.prompt_en: A brick wall icon standing between a source and a simple stick figure. No people.
shots.narration: 屏蔽：在源和人之间放合适材料。

shots.scene: 小研先看源罐上的空白标签，再选屏蔽
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads the blank label on a source container before choosing a shield from a shelf.
shots.narration: 放屏蔽前，先弄清是什么源。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现四块积木
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four floating building blocks stacked into a tower.
shots.narration: 四个剂量量，层层递进。

shots.scene: 成绩徽章和器官砝码图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a grade badge and an organ weight. No people.
shots.narration: 射线看权重，器官看敏感性。

shots.scene: 地球和计数柱图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of the Earth with small dots and two count bars. No people.
shots.narration: 本底无处不在，测量先扣本底。

shots.scene: 火柴和彩票图标
shots.prompt_en: A match icon and a lottery ticket icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 确定性有阈值，随机性看概率。

shots.scene: 时钟、尺子、砖墙三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green check marks: a clock, a ruler and a brick wall. No people.
shots.narration: 时间、距离、屏蔽，按射线选材料。

shots.scene: 计算器和两个源罐图标
shots.prompt_en: A calculator icon next to two small source container icons. No people.
shots.narration: 例题会算，常用核素常数记牢。

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着复习卡片，在源柜前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot hugs a stack of blank review cards and waves goodbye in front of a locked source cabinet.
shots.narration: 复习好原理，管好每个源！
